note: THE NAMED CAUSE OF THE WINDOW DRIFT. JIT loading brings a model back when the server is asked for one that is not loaded, at the model's DEFAULT context rather than at whatever the last explicit `lms load` requested. note: CLOSES THE OLDEST OPEN POINT, AND THE HYPOTHESIS WAS RIGHT. truncateMiddle keeps the system prompt and first user message and removes the MIDDLE of the context, so a model copying a file out of the prompt loses the middle of its own source and then closes the block normally. One mechanism accounts for four independent symptoms: the properly closed </file>, the 81 lines gone from the middle rather than the end, finish_reason stop, and the retry reporting an identical prompt_tokens after ~6,000 tokens were appended. It does not change the pre-flight, which prevents the overflow entirely -- what it establishes is that WHEN THE PRE-FLIGHT IS WRONG THE FAILURE IS SILENT BY DESIGN, which is the argument for the lms ps cross-check and for the operator to consider stopAtLimit

An expired credential, a context overflow or a crash partway through would have been archived as a complete task and scored as one. Non-zero exit is the CLI failing and is distinct from the AGENT failing the task -- claude --print exits 0 either way, and a genuine failure to solve it is caught by the acceptance predicate as accepted false, which is data and is kept. Three defects now in this one rule across three turns: the timeout conflation, the empty-observation gap, and the exit status. Each time the field that decided it was one the rule was never given

method: called classifyRun twice with an identical exit-1 failure, once at 1000ms and once at the 2700000ms budget, holding every other field equal
note: THE SAME FAILURE WAS INVALID EARLY AND CENSORED-AND-VALID LATE. Censoring read errorCode ETIMEDOUT OR exitCode non-zero AND wallMs at least budgetMs, and the second half used DURATION as evidence that WE stopped the process. Duration says how long something took, not who ended it. An arm that hung on a network call for the whole budget and then died of an expired credential was archived as a legitimate budget-exhausted observation, and did not need to have originated anything to qualify. Only ETIMEDOUT is positive evidence, since spawnSync sets it exactly when it kills a child at the timeout it was given.
